response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with strong systems and tooling interests, but the profile lacks the core requirements for this role: there is no meaningful Kotlin experience, only marginal Java exposure, and no evidence of Spring or enterprise JVM framework work. His IDE-adjacent experience (C/C++ components for LabWindows/CVI) is brief and dated, and his career center of gravity is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang rather than the JVM ecosystem.
strengths: Long, varied engineering career with proven ownership of complex systems and low-latency services
Genuine interest in developer tooling — test frameworks, test runners, MCP code generators, and prior IDE component work at National Instruments
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, workshops, and conference talks
concerns: No Kotlin experience and only peripheral Java usage — the role demands deep JVM expertise
No demonstrated experience with Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise application servers
Primary stack (TypeScript/Node.js, DLang) diverges significantly from the JVM/IDE-internals focus

key_factors.factor: Developer-tooling interest and IDE component background
